dedupe_keys.name: india droughtset village level monthly spei drought dataset 1981 2022

description: India DroughtSet gives a monthly three-month Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index (SPEI-3), suited to agricultural drought monitoring, joined to Indian village boundaries and census attributes. The DANS record says SPEI was computed on 5 km grid cells from CHIRPS precipitation and GLEAM evapotranspiration for 1981 to 2022. It was deposited by T Pareek of ITC, University of Twente (version 2.1, updated August 2026) under the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence, open access and free to download, as CSV, MapInfo mid/mif and NetCDF files with a README. Coverage is India at village level, but the files read cover Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh only, though the description says major Indian states. Caveats: the CSV and mid files are large (up to about 680 MB each), and village SPEI values are interpolated from the 5 km grid. For simulation it gives village-scale drought exposure linked to census attributes, for crop loss, rural livelihood, migration and water supply stress modelling. Related catalogue records include the ERA5 reanalysis and the other drought index datasets in this batch, such as the EDO Combined Drought Indicator.
